messages:
emma_mkt: Quick update from today's interview with NimbusWorks. Short quote we can use: "Redwood made inference predictable and materially cheaper for production." Need legal review and webinar routing.

ryan_growth: Nice. Paste verbatim and attach clip. I'll cut a 10s social teaser once approved.

emma_mkt: Verbatim: "Redwood made inference predictable and materially cheaper for production, which let us ship features faster." Clip uploaded.

claire_legal: Suggest softer language to avoid "materially" unless they put a number in the release. Proposed: "significantly reduced per-inference costs while keeping latency stable". Confirm with their comms and attach the signed release.

josh_cs: They signed our standard advocacy release. I'll ping their PR for wording OK and exact attribution (name + title). Also asked we link to their public benchmark gist.

infra-bot: Reminder: marketing publish checklist requires signed release, comms approval, SFDC campaign, and CDN assets.

ryan_growth: For routing: map fields email, company, role, use_case, intent_score, attended_webinar. High intent -> AE queue. Can infra team set campaign after copy is final?

josh_cs: I'll create the SFDC campaign and share the ID. Also confirmed no embargo.

emma_mkt: PR approved the softened quote and provided attribution: "Maya Chen, Head of ML, NimbusWorks". Landing draft updated and release attached. Ready to schedule promos when campaign is live.

ryan_growth: Great, I'll load social variants and set paid A/B tests. Thanks team :tada:
